title: Migrate OpenCode to Home-Manager programs.opencode Module
description:
Migrate the manual OpenCode configuration (currently using xdg.configFile) to use the new home-manager programs.opencode module, which allows setting all configuration options directly without creating the xdg config file manually.

## Current State

**File:** modules/programs/prism/opencode.nix (lines 1-303)

Currently uses:
- Manual xdg.configFile."opencode/config.json".text = builtins.toJSON approach
- Inline JSON config with all settings
- Manages command directory, plugin directory, AGENTS.md via xdg

Configuration includes:
- Theme: config.theme.opencodename
- Agent: soku with detailed 100+ line prompt for beads workflow
- MCP servers: playwright (enabled), atlassian (disabled)
- Permissions: comprehensive bash, edit, webfetch rules
- Plugins: opencode-gemini-auth@latest, ./plugin/soku-hooks.js
- Packages: nodejs_24, opencode, beads
- Shell alias with environment prefix

## Desired State

- Use programs.opencode.enable = true
- Define all configuration through module options
- Preserve all existing functionality and settings identically
- Keep file copying (command, plugin directories) working

## Key Settings to Preserve

- Theme from config.theme.opencodename
- Soku agent with complete prompt (critical for beads workflow)
- MCP playwright with chromium executable path
- All permission rules
- Shell alias with env prefix
- Packages list
- Plugins list

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All existing OpenCode settings preserved (theme, agents, MCP, permissions, plugins)
- [ ] Configuration uses programs.opencode module options
- [ ] No manual xdg.configFile creation for config.json
- [ ] File copying (command/, plugin/) still works
- [ ] nix fmt passes
- [ ] darwin-rebuild switch builds successfully
- [ ] OpenCode starts with all config intact
- [ ] Soku agent has full prompt and beads integration
- [ ] Permissions unchanged
- [ ] Environment variables and theme references work

## Resources

- Home Manager release-25.11 documentation for programs.opencode options
- Current Config: modules/programs/prism/opencode.nix:7-300
- Related Files:
  - modules/home-manager/default.nix
  - ./opencode/command/ (preserve)
  - ./opencode/plugin/ (preserve)
  - machines/m1mac/configuration.nix

## Notes

- Maintain backwards compatibility with existing behavior
- Preserve zsh alias for opencode with environment prefixes
- Keep soku agent prompt exactly as-is (critical for beads workflow)
- Verify MCP playwright chromium path is preserved
- Test beads integration via hooks works after migration
